rows.grounds: genitive plural of ripu; denotes those targeted for eradication
act of uprooting or driving away; object of the verb
fused form of nayati and eva; expresses bringing about the result
nominal subject of the negated existential sense

items.question: Is the eradication of enemies certainly brought about by this practice?
premises: The practice leads to the eradication of enemies.
The emphatic particle reinforces the certainty of this effect.
The text explicitly denies the presence of any doubt.
items.inference: Therefore, the eradication of enemies is an assured outcome.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical analysis of uccāṭan as a nominal or participial form is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And it indeed brings about the eradication of enemies; there is no doubt.
